column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_plugin_start_refuses_a_suspended_tenant_test.go's SQL Server arm needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which this job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) does not supply. The PostgreSQL arm and the mock-store test run here. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestAPluginStartIsRefusedForASuspendedTenant -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one test.
